item.title: [IGNITE-13569] disable archiving + walCompactionEnabled probably broke reading from wal on server restart
item.description:
• Start cluster with 4 server node
  • Preload
  • Start 4 clients
  • Start transactional loading
  • Wait 10 sec
    While loading:
    For node in server nodes:
    Kill -9 node
    Wait 20 sec
    Return node back
    Wait 20 sec

Looks like node can't read all wal files that was generated before start node back
